metas.name: Community
metas.description: This cult-classic features a high-concept meta-humor and a lovable ensemble cast that aligns perfectly with the smart, witty writing of The Good Place and Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: If you enjoyed the optimistic and heartfelt comedy of Ted Lasso, you will love the uplifting workplace dynamics and quirky characters of Pawnee.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: An easy-to-watch, hilarious ensemble sitcom with a similar blend of slapstick and heart found in New Girl and Scrubs.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: This British comedy classic captures the awkward tech-humor of Silicon Valley with the distinct, dry wit found in Peep Show.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A perfect comfort show that provides the wholesome family dynamic of King of the Hill combined with the clever animated humor of The Simpsons.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: Matches the fast-paced, irreverent, and adult-oriented animated comedy seen in Rick and Morty and Futurama.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: As a fan of Gogglebox, you'll appreciate this hilarious, low-stakes British competition that focuses on comedy and personality.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A brilliant mockumentary that blends supernatural elements with dry comedy, appealing to your love for Dirk Gently and Peep Show.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: Features a dense, layered comedy style and dysfunctional family dynamic that fans of It's Always Sunny and Silicon Valley will appreciate.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: A quintessential feel-good show that evolves from cynical humor to the kind of heartwarming growth seen in Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: Created by the co-creator of Rick and Morty, this offers the same sci-fi absurdity and high-energy comedic chaos.

metas.name: The Inbetweeners
metas.description: This British staple masters the 'cringe comedy' and awkward social situations found in Peep Show and Top Buzzer.

metas.name: Curb Your Enthusiasm
metas.description: The spiritual father of cringe comedy; it shares the same unapologetic, selfish character humor as It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: A British cult hit filled with pop-culture references and surrealist humor that bridges the gap between Peep Show and Futurama.

metas.name: Peacemaker
metas.description: Matches the violent, colorful, and darkly comedic tone of Fallout while maintaining a core of unexpected heart.

metas.name: VEEP
metas.description: The rapid-fire insults and cynical look at professional life will resonate with fans of Silicon Valley and It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Black Books
metas.description: A surreal and cynical British sitcom about a bookshop owner that fans of Peep Show's misanthropy will find hilarious.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: A high-speed, joke-dense sitcom that mirrors the satirical wit and fast pacing of The Simpsons.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A high-energy, hilarious look at teenage life that shares the chaotic energy and regional charm of Brassic.

metas.name: Ghosts
metas.description: The original UK version is a charming, lighthearted comedy with a supernatural twist, perfect for fans of The Good Place.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: An animated sci-fi comedy that celebrates the genre with the same affection and humor found in Futurama.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A lighthearted, inclusive, and very funny pirate comedy that shares the same wholesome but wacky spirit as Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Nathan For You
metas.description: A unique blend of reality and scripted cringe-comedy that fans of It's Always Sunny's social awkwardness will enjoy.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: Set in a video game studio, this captures the workplace satire of Silicon Valley with the ensemble heart of Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A hidden gem about caterers in LA that features a cynical, hilarious ensemble perfect for fans of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A warm, easy-watching sitcom about a family-run store that provides the same comfort as King of the Hill.

metas.name: The Last Man on Earth
metas.description: A post-apocalyptic comedy that finds humor in the end of the world, making it a great lighter companion to Fallout.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: From the creator of One-Punch Man, this offers incredible action and hilarious comedy with a very sweet, emotional core.

metas.name: Final Space
metas.description: An epic animated space opera with a lot of humor and heart, ideal for fans of Futurama and Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Cougar Town
metas.description: Created by the creator of Scrubs and Ted Lasso, it's a quintessential 'comfort show' about a close-knit group of friends.

metas.name: Miracle Workers
metas.description: An anthology comedy that plays with high-concept religious and historical themes, similar to the creativity in The Good Place.

metas.name: The Great British Bake Off
metas.description: The ultimate low-stress, 'background' show that matches the gentle, observational charm of Gogglebox.

metas.name: How I Met Your Mother
metas.description: A staple comfort sitcom with a strong central friendship group that will appeal to fans of New Girl and Scrubs.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A sharp, underrated corporate satire that fits perfectly alongside Silicon Valley and the wackier side of The Good Place.

metas.name: Malcolm in the Middle
metas.description: A high-energy, creative live-action sitcom that captures the chaotic family energy of The Simpsons.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A musical comedy with a deadpan, awkward style that fans of Peep Show and Master of None will appreciate.

metas.name: Toast of London
metas.description: Matt Berry’s surreal and bombastic performance here is perfect for fans of the eccentric humor in Peep Show and Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Inside Job
metas.description: A workplace comedy set in a world where every conspiracy theory is true; it shares the sci-fi wit of Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Resident Alien
metas.description: A quirky, sci-fi mystery-comedy about an alien hiding in a small town, matching the 'fun weirdness' of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Bored to Death
metas.description: A quirky, low-key comedy about a writer who moonlights as an unlicensed private eye, perfect for fans of Master of None.
